jose-luis-solache.text: Voted No on SB 79, which allows transit-oriented housing development, on the Assembly floor (Sept 11, 2025). The bill passed.
Voted Aye on AB 130 (Housing, budget trailer bill) on the Assembly floor, including concurrence on June 30, 2025.
Voted Aye on SB 131 (Public Resources budget trailer bill) on the Assembly floor, June 30, 2025.
Voted Aye on SB 627 (law enforcement: masks) on the Assembly floor, Sept 9, 2025.
Voted Aye on AB 49, limiting immigration enforcement at school sites, on the Assembly floor (May 27 and Sept 2, 2025).
Voted Aye on SB 81 (health and care facilities: information sharing), an urgency measure, Sept 2, 2025.

Voted Aye on AB 1078 (Firearms) on the Assembly floor, June 2 and Sept 11, 2025.

jose-luis-solache.text: Said of ICE raids in Paramount: "These families deserve protection - not tear gas. Not raids. Not fear." Pledged to demand "transparency, justice, and dignity for every resident - regardless of immigration status."

source.title: Assemblymember Solache Responds to ICE Activity and Tear Gas Deployment in Paramount (June 6, 2025)

jose-luis-solache.text: Introduced AB 1708 to let cities under 300,000 people apply for state HHAP homelessness funding through their Continuum of Care. Said it would "deliver local solutions" with "compassion." Sponsored by the League of California Cities.

source.title: Assemblymember Solache Introduces the HHAP Pathways for Cities Act (Feb 11, 2026)

jose-luis-solache.text: Supported the 2025-26 budget, citing Medi-Cal access, protections for reproductive health providers, K-12 funding, rejected UC/CSU cuts, and preserved housing and homelessness prevention programs.

source.title: Statement from Assemblymember Solache on the 2025-2026 State Budget (June 30, 2025)
